blocks.orig: Front-row seats to the Serengeti, with coffee in hand! The Luwela Camp in central Serengeti lies on Makoma Hill, an area renowned for year-round wildlife viewings. The camp has 9 solar-powered tents, each with a private veranda, lounge seating, and wide views over the plains. Inside, expect super king or twin beds, a desk, and an en-suite bathroom with a flush toilet, vanity, and a large solar-heated shower. One family unit links two full-size tents with a shared viewing deck, while shared spaces focus on relaxed dining and sundowners, keeping the feel simple, open, and close to the action!
